name: OpenTyrian2000
description: OpenTyrian2000 is an open-source port of the DOS game Tyrian.
long_description:
OpenTyrian2000 is an open-source port of the DOS game Tyrian. It is a fork of OpenTyrian, with the end goal being to replicate the experience of Tyrian 2000 as closely as possible.
Tyrian is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shooter.  The story is set in 20031 where you play as Trent Hawkins, a skilled fighter-pilot employed to fight MicroSol and save the galaxy.
Tyrian features a story mode, one- and two-player arcade modes, and networked multiplayer.
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
